title: Crowned Witch Queen
description: A pale woman with vibrant red braided hair and freckles wears an ornate golden crown decorated with beetles, leaves, and purple gems. She holds a golden keyring in her right hand while gazing upward against a dark, mystical background filled with floating alchemical symbols, lit candles, and glowing orbs.
